description: This Java source file defines the StatsRoute class, which sets up HTTP routes using Akka HTTP framework within an Eclipse Ditto-based gateway service. It provides endpoints under /stats for retrieving various statistics related to Things and DevOps commands, including detailed statistics and search count functionalities.

classes.name: StatsRoute
classes.description: Defines HTTP routing for statistics endpoints within the Eclipse Ditto gateway, supporting routes for general statistics, detailed statistics, and search counts. It extends AbstractRoute and uses Akka HTTP directives to map URLs to command processing logic.

methods.name: buildStatsRoute
methods.description: Constructs the main route under /stats, setting up sub-routes for different statistics endpoints.

methods.name: buildSubRoutes
methods.description: Sets up sub-routes for /stats/things and /stats/search, linking to detailed and search-specific handlers.

methods.name: buildDetailsRoute
methods.description: Creates the /stats/things/details route, incorporating DevOps basic authentication and parameter extraction.

methods.name: handleDevOpsPerRequest
methods.description: Handles a DevOps request by executing the provided command and returning an HttpResponse asynchronously.

methods.name: handleSudoCountThingsPerRequest
methods.description: Handles the /stats/search endpoint to count 'things' and return a JSON response with the count.

methods.name: buildDevOpsDittoHeaders
methods.description: Builds Ditto headers including schema version and correlation ID for DevOps requests.
